description: Storing API keys, signing secrets, and third-party tokens that Apex must consume — Protected Custom Metadata in a managed package, Protected Custom Settings, Encrypted Custom Fields, Apex Crypto, and what to NEVER do (hardcode, unprotected CMDT, System.debug). NOT for callout authentication — use apex/apex-named-credentials-patterns. NOT for computing the HMAC or signature itself — use apex/apex-encoding-and-crypto. NOT for record-level Shield data encryption — use security/platform-encryption.
inputs: Type of secret (callout auth, signing key, symmetric crypto key, lookup token)
Whether the code lives in a managed package or unmanaged DX project
name: apex-secrets-and-protected-cmdt
official_sources: Apex Developer Guide 264 — protected custom settings public outside a managed package, readable by guest user (salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt L13709-13713); `public` = all Apex in the package (L3661-3663); debug log retention 24 h / 7 days (L38605)

Packaging 264 — `@NamespaceAccessible` across same-namespace 2GP packages; `global` across all namespaces (pkg2_dev.txt L17987-17990); sfdx 264 scratch-org shared-namespace exposure (sfdx_dev.txt L18905-18912)

Apex Reference 262 — protected CMDT behaves as public outside managed package (L170826-170828); `getInstance(developerName)` returns null on no match (L204618-204620); hierarchy `getInstance()` (L205082-205084); Security Guide 262 — Classic encrypted text 175-char limit (salesforce_security_impl_guide.txt L2522)
Custom Metadata Types — Protect Sensitive Data — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_metadata_security.htm
Apex Developer Guide — Named Credentials as Callout Endpoints — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_callouts_named_credentials.htm
Apex Developer Guide — Custom Settings (Protected visibility in managed packages) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/apex_customsettings.htm
outputs: Storage decision (Named/External Credential, Protected CMDT, Protected Custom Setting, Encrypted Field, off-platform vault)
Apex retrieval pattern with @NamespaceAccessible where required
